Build unique study identifiers for a table of signatures

Source: R/simple.R
dot-make_unique_study_ID.Rd

Generates a study identifier the way curatedMetagenomicData does it: the first author from the Authors list column (usually surname + initials, e.g. "ZellerG") with whitespace stripped, plus the year, e.g. "ZellerG_2014". Duplicates get a ".1", ".2", ... suffix. Also normalizes bare DOIs (starting with "10.") to full https://doi.org/ links.

Usage

.make_unique_study_ID(bsdb.df)

Arguments

bsdb.df

data.frame produced by importBugSigDB, pre-filtered as desired

Value

bsdb.df with a new leading Study Identifier column

Note

Author: Giacomo Antonello (2025-03-17)

Examples

full.dat <- bugsigdbr::importBugSigDB()
#> Using cached version from 2026-11-09 16:28:46
bugSigSimple:::.make_unique_study_ID(full.dat[1:10, ])
